verdict.rationale: Official SDKs are a fair question for a local LLM runtime that exposes an HTTP server API, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents only the executable, a CLI mode, a Web UI and HTTP server/API options. No first-party SDK libraries are mentioned, and an HTTP API alone is a building block, not an SDK.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
